items.title: Barclays joins Morgan Stanley in seeing S&P 500 at 8,700 by end-2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays and Morgan Stanley both see the S&P 500 reaching 8,700 in their 2027 outlooks, with earnings growth expected to drive gains after the recent sell-off.

items.title: Morgan Stanley sees ECB cuts in 2028, favours Bunds and gilts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley expects the European Central Bank to cut interest rates to 2.25% by the end of 2028, against market consensus, as inflation eases rather than economic growth weakens.

items.title: Morgan Stanley is now maximum overweight global equities. Here’s why
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley moved to a maximum overweight on global equities in its 2027 outlook, saying an intact artificial intelligence capital expenditure cycle should carry resilient economic and earnings growth into next year.
